svg.aria-label: Observed tokens three-run N/L averages by tier
svg.text: One N/L bar pair per completed task, plus an equal-weight average of the completed task means in each tier.
Absolute mean tokens above bars; each task has its own scale. Blue = N; orange = L. Generated 2026-09-22 15:23 UTC.
Pending, scored-failure, and infrastructure tasks have no three-run mean. Token means are observed lower bounds if incomplete.
